Which signals the assess flow rates: window (Now, Imminent, key date within 183 days, or exposed; ADR 0012) or all (every active signal except service health, once; ADR 0012 addendum 2026-11-22, within the 500-credit cap)

Most signals the assess flow rates in one run (0 = no cap). A credit safeguard: new installs start at 25 so the first night can't run up a large bill (Simon, 2026-11-24); raise it once the cost is known

Most estate assessments the assess flow sends to the prompt in one run (0 = no cap). Separate from rating_max_per_run (install test finding 15, Simon 2026-11-24). An exposed signal over the cap is deferred, not skipped: it is assessed on a later run. Usually only a few a night; a large estate change or switching demo data on can need many

Higher per-run cap for the first weeks of an install, while the backlog of Microsoft's existing changes is fingerprinted and rated (install test finding 14, Simon 2026-11-24). Used by fingerprint, rating and estate assessment until catchup_until; it never lowers a cap. 0 = no catch-up

Date (yyyy-MM-dd) the catch-up ends; from that date the normal caps apply. Import-Config.ps1 sets it to the install date + 14 days when it first creates this setting, and never changes it after. Clear it to end catch-up early. Ignored unless it is a yyyy-MM-dd date within the next 120 days

Most signals the fingerprint flow sends to the prompt in one run (0 = no cap). A credit safeguard: new installs start at 25 so the first night can't run up a large bill (Simon, 2026-11-24); raise it once the cost is known

Synthetic demo data (ADR 0022): on or off. Off: the match and assess flows skip it (no credits spent on it) and the Radar page hides it; nothing is deleted. Load it with setup/Import-DemoData.ps1 and remove it with setup/Remove-DemoData.ps1. Never load it in production.
